g.text: Crow's-foot notation. PK primary key, FK foreign key, UK unique key.
FK <name>: the foreign key references a table that is not drawn here.
Dashed boxes belong to another diagram (key only).
UK*: partial unique index (unique only for rows matching its WHERE condition).
moderation_appeals, copyright_claims and forum_restrictions have no FK constraint in
the final schema (plain reference columns such as moderation_action_id,
target_type/target_id, user_id), so no relation is drawn for them.
